name: Unchained
status: early prototype · ~25k lines · not public yet
facts: Enter a domain or a Discord ID: it detects the type and queries every matching source in parallel
Every source is a plugin in its own process, with a timeout and an output limit
Live: WHOIS/DNS, crt.sh, Discord. Hand-written graph layout; scrypt, TOTP 2FA, CSRF protection

name: Reforestation Planning Map
tagline: where to plant trees after fires and hurricanes
facts: Finds and ranks U.S. Forest Service land that needs replanting, for nonprofits and volunteers
Scores 30 m cells on six factors from public federal and satellite data, then groups them into zones
851 zones (~72,000 acres) in Plumas NF, CA, plus 6 after Hurricane Helene. Weights: untested heuristics

name: Knowly
tagline: a personal map of everything I want to learn
facts: A dark tree of knowledge: a node lights up when you actually do something with it
Local-first: your data stays on your own machine
